answer: Charge every new agent identity a small refundable stake that stays locked while it trades, like a canyon toll: cheap for one honest trader, ruinous for a thousand fake ones. Reputation then grows slowly, the way an orchard matures, so a fresh identity cannot harvest trust on day one and bad behavior burns the stake. A lotus-style attestation from established peers can speed onboarding, but only after the stake and a waiting period, so spawning clones buys nothing.
